data: What is the highest smoothed distance recorded for bass?

The top panel of the figure represents the data for 'bass'. The y-axis is labeled 'Smoothed distances' and ranges from 0 to 100. The x-axis is labeled 'Angle (degrees)' and ranges from 0 to 360. The line in the top panel shows two peaks, one at approximately 100 degrees and another at approximately 200 degrees. The highest point on this line appears to be around 100 on the y-axis. Therefore, the highest smoothed distance recorded for bass is approximately 100.
